{{Quote|Besides, fightin' in public's against the town decrees, ain't it?|Miner|<ref name="SotME" />}}
The '''town decrees''', also called '''mine law''', were the declarations of law within the five [[mine towns]] on [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]]-controlled [[Mimban/Legends|Mimban]]. Among the decrees were laws against public fighting, and against use of deadly weapons. The decrees called upon all [[miner]]s to apprehend any lawbreakers if possible. Beyond this, the law was enforced by Imperial [[Stormtrooper/Legends|Stormtroopers]] under the command of [[Captain-Supervisor]] [[Grammel]]<ref name="SotME" />
